items.item_text: Current Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) or appropriate sub-specialty license issued by the State of California Department of Public Health.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and a pre-employment physical.
A Bachelor's degree in a related discipline.
Previous experience as a CLS in a clinical laboratory setting.
Two or more (2+) years of clinical lab experience.
Under supervision, the Clinical Laboratory Scientist performs a wide variety of routine technical procedures and a limited number of specialized procedures in support of the Urology Clinic.

This is a journey-level position in which the incumbent performs the full range of laboratory duties, including preanalytical processes such as specimen procurement, processing, preparation, receiving, and accessioning; reagent preparation; laboratory testing; and data analysis and reporting. The position also supports laboratory quality assurance and compliance, oversees the work of technical support staff, assists coworkers with workload demands, and participates in teaching and staff training activities.
Graduation from college with a major in a relevant field.
Proficiency in tissue culture and cryobanking/cryopreservation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
Andrology and tissue banking background strongly preferred.
Demonstrated knowledge and proficiency in laboratory techniques, including specimen collection, handling, processing, and analysis.
Knowledge of sterile techniques, aseptic procedures, and laboratory safety practices.
Knowledge of laboratory quality control, quality assurance, and applicable regulatory and compliance standards.
Demonstrated ability to accurately document, interpret, and report laboratory results in accordance with established protocols.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, prioritize responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
